_doc: userId -> { name, roles[] } for your workspace. Each entry has a list of roles ∈ {po, designer, dev, skip}. Any role in {po, designer} routes to the PO/Designer variant; 'dev' routes to the Developer variant; 'skip' is never grilled. Update when team composition changes.
_source: GET /api/v2/team/{WORKSPACE_ID}; roles set by workspace admin.
